slug.py:
"""Utilities for generating simple ASCII slugs."""


def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Return a lowercase ASCII slug, using hyphens between word runs.

    ASCII letters and digits are retained; every run of any other characters,
    including non-ASCII Unicode characters, is replaced by one hyphen.
    """
    parts: list[str] = []
    in_separator = True  # Also suppresses leading separators.

    for char in text:
        codepoint = ord(char)
        if 65 <= codepoint <= 90:  # ASCII A-Z
            parts.append(chr(codepoint + 32))
            in_separator = False
        elif 97 <= codepoint <= 122 or 48 <= codepoint <= 57:
            parts.append(char)
            in_separator = False
        elif not in_separator:
            parts.append("-")
            in_separator = True

    if parts and parts[-1] == "-":
        parts.pop()
    return "".join(parts)
